_comment: Catalog of standalone environment props. width (px) is a deliberate size calibration - the source art has no consistent scale relative to a character or to each other, since every prop was generated independently; height follows automatically, keeping the source aspect ratio. blocksMovement (default true if omitted) marks solid objects a character can't walk through - only low, flat, walk-over-able ground decoration is false. `name` (display title) and `description` (examine flavor text, added 2026-09-10) back GameScene::interactWithNearby()'s prop-examine path: pressing E near a spawned prop with no NPC closer shows `name`/`description` via showInfoMessage(), exactly like the built-in compass item, no scripting required. Every prop in this file has both - if a future prop is added without them, examine falls back to the catalog key itself rather than failing.

cottage_a.name: Snug Cottage
cottage_a.description: Thatch on top, moss in the thatch, and somewhere under all that a family who insists the roof is 'basically fine.'

cottage_b.name: Weathered Cottage
cottage_b.description: The kind of house that has settled a little more than its owners are willing to admit out loud.

well.name: Village Well
well.description: Deep, cold, and - if you listen close - humming a note that has nothing to do with echo.

fence_straight.name: Wooden Fence
fence_straight.description: Keeps the goats in and, on a good day, the goats' opinions to themselves.

fence_corner.name: Fence Corner
fence_corner.description: Where two fences meet and neither one wants to admit the gate should really be here.

market_stall.name: Market Stall
market_stall.description: Empty at this hour, but the smell of yesterday's bread hasn't gotten the memo.

haystack.name: Haystack
haystack.description: Somewhere in here is a pitchfork nobody's seen since spring. Dig at your own risk.

signpost.name: Signpost
signpost.description: One arm points to safety, the other to adventure. Both arms are lying a little.

cart.name: Farm Cart
cart.description: One wheel squeaks in a key Lara's ear insists is almost musical.

barrels_crates.name: Barrels & Crates
barrels_crates.description: Stacked with the quiet confidence of something that has never once been organized on purpose.

chicken_coop.name: Chicken Coop
chicken_coop.description: Currently unoccupied, which either means the chickens are elsewhere or extremely good at hiding.

windmill.name: Windmill
windmill.description: Turns lazily even when there's no wind, which the village has collectively agreed not to think too hard about.

blacksmith_forge.name: Blacksmith's Forge
blacksmith_forge.description: Cold right now, but the anvil still rings faintly if you put an ear to it - old habit, apparently.

chapel.name: Chapel
chapel.description: Small, plain, and somehow always exactly warm enough inside, regardless of the season.

water_trough.name: Water Trough
water_trough.description: Full, clean, and suspiciously free of algae for something that just sits outside all day.

wheelbarrow.name: Wheelbarrow
wheelbarrow.description: Tipped at an angle that suggests it was set down mid-argument and never picked back up.

vegetable_garden.name: Vegetable Garden
vegetable_garden.description: Neat rows of turnips growing with more enthusiasm than the soil around here really deserves.

bench.name: Wooden Bench
bench.description: Worn smooth in exactly one spot, by exactly one person, sitting exactly there for years.

dovecote.name: Dovecote
dovecote.description: A small tower of pigeon apartments. Rent is free. Reviews are, presumably, mixed.

notice_board.name: Notice Board
notice_board.description: Mostly lost cats and one very old, very confident hand-drawn map to 'treasure, probably.'

pine_tree.name: Pine Tree
pine_tree.description: Tall, green, and entirely unbothered by whatever's humming underground nearby.

oak_tree.name: Old Oak
oak_tree.description: Been here longer than the village has, and looks like it plans to outlast the argument about who owns the land under it.

dead_tree.name: Dead Tree
dead_tree.description: Bare branches reaching for a sky that, honestly, isn't offering much back.

burnt_stump.name: Burnt Stump
burnt_stump.description: Scorched black and hollow inside - lightning, or something with worse manners.

bush.name: Bush
bush.description: Rustles slightly more than the breeze can account for. Probably fine.

rocks_small.name: Loose Rocks
rocks_small.description: A small pile of rocks doing an admirable job of just being rocks.

boulder_large.name: Large Boulder
boulder_large.description: Immovable, indifferent, and clearly winning whatever argument it's having with gravity.

fallen_log.name: Fallen Log
fallen_log.description: Soft with moss and, if Lara's not mistaken, gently warmer than the air around it.

reeds.name: Reeds
reeds.description: Whisper against each other in a rhythm that's almost - not quite - a language.

wildflowers.name: Wildflowers
wildflowers.description: Small, bright, and blooming in colors that don't appear in any dye recipe Lara knows.

cliff_face.name: Cliff Face
cliff_face.description: Sheer rock with a long way down and an even longer way to explain the fall afterward.

waterfall.name: Waterfall
waterfall.description: Loud, cold, and drowning out the hum underground for a merciful few seconds.

wooden_bridge.name: Wooden Bridge
wooden_bridge.description: Creaks under every step, purely as a personality trait - it's structurally fine, probably.

tree_stump.name: Tree Stump
tree_stump.description: Flat enough to sit on, round enough to count the rings, if counting to 'a lot' interests you.

berry_bush.name: Berry Bush
berry_bush.description: Heavy with fruit that's either delicious or extremely educational. Only one way to find out.

lily_pads.name: Lily Pads
lily_pads.description: Floating in a neat cluster, holding up absolutely nothing except a small, unbothered frog.

mushroom_cluster.name: Mushroom Cluster
mushroom_cluster.description: Clustered close together and glowing very faintly, in a way that raises more questions than it answers.

snowy_pine.name: Snow-Dusted Pine
snowy_pine.description: Dressed in white and holding perfectly still, like it's hoping not to be asked to do anything.

ivy_rock.name: Ivy-Covered Rock
ivy_rock.description: More ivy than rock, at this point. The rock is basically a rumor underneath.

anthill.name: Anthill
anthill.description: A small, extremely organized city that has never once had a zoning dispute.

data_pillar.name: Data Pillar
data_pillar.description: Hums with old current and older information, most of which nobody's bothered to read in decades.

holo_terminal.name: Holo-Terminal
holo_terminal.description: Flickers to life if you get close enough, then displays absolutely nothing useful. Very on-brand for terminals.

downed_drone.name: Downed Drone
downed_drone.description: Lying still, one rotor bent, clearly having a worse day than anyone else in the area.

conduit_coil.name: Conduit Coil
conduit_coil.description: Warm to stand near, and humming that same note Lara can't quite place - or can't quite stop hearing.

overgrown_solar_array.name: Overgrown Solar Array
overgrown_solar_array.description: Half swallowed by vines that seem, weirdly, to be helping it along rather than choking it out.

dormant_sentry_turret.name: Dormant Sentry Turret
dormant_sentry_turret.description: Powered down, thankfully, and pointed at absolutely nothing in particular.

cyber_supply_crate.name: Cyber Supply Crate
cyber_supply_crate.description: Sealed, labeled in a script nobody local can read, and suspiciously heavier than it looks.

signal_relay_mast.name: Signal Relay Mast
signal_relay_mast.description: Still transmitting something, faintly, to an audience that stopped listening generations ago.

salvage_pile.name: Salvage Pile
salvage_pile.description: A junk heap of old parts, at least three of which are definitely still live. Poke carefully.

vendor_kiosk.name: Vendor Kiosk
vendor_kiosk.description: Long abandoned, its screen dark - though for one unsettling second, it looked like it flickered on for Lara specifically.

haunted_cottage.name: Haunted Cottage
haunted_cottage.description: The door is closed. It was open a second ago. Best not to dwell on it.

withered_well.name: Withered Well
withered_well.description: Dry as bone, and colder than a dry well has any right to be.

broken_fence.name: Broken Fence
broken_fence.description: Snapped clean in the middle, from the inside out, by the look of the splinters.

gravestone_cluster.name: Gravestone Cluster
gravestone_cluster.description: Names worn smooth by weather and time - illegible now, which feels less like an accident than a mercy.

dead_twisted_tree.name: Twisted Dead Tree
dead_twisted_tree.description: Grown into a shape no living tree ever bends into. Whatever grew it wasn't patient - or wasn't kind.

will_o_wisp.name: Will-o'-the-Wisp
will_o_wisp.description: A small, cold light that drifts just out of reach. Following it seems like a story that ends badly.

cobweb_cart.name: Cobweb-Draped Cart
cobweb_cart.description: Hasn't moved in years, and the spiders have very much taken that as an invitation.

haunted_signpost.name: Leaning Signpost
haunted_signpost.description: Both arms point the same direction now. That direction is 'away.'

rotted_haystack.name: Rotted Haystack
rotted_haystack.description: Black and slumping, held together mostly by mildew and bad memories.

ruined_chapel.name: Ruined Chapel
ruined_chapel.description: Roof caved in, pews overturned - whatever used to be prayed for here, it didn't work.

burnt_cottage_ruin.name: Burnt Cottage Ruin
burnt_cottage_ruin.description: Charred beams reaching up like the house is still trying to protect whoever was inside.

rubble_pile.name: Rubble Pile
rubble_pile.description: A heap of broken stone, quietly and thoroughly done being a building.

charred_tree.name: Charred Tree
charred_tree.description: Black from root to crown. Whatever burned it didn't come from anywhere near the sun.

wrecked_cart.name: Wrecked Cart
wrecked_cart.description: One wheel gone entirely, the other three politely pretending that's not a problem.

scorched_fence_remains.name: Scorched Fence Remains
scorched_fence_remains.description: A few blackened posts, standing guard over nothing left worth guarding.

impact_crater.name: Impact Crater
impact_crater.description: Scorched at the center, glassy at the edges. Something hit here, hard, and hasn't been explained since.

collapsed_well.name: Collapsed Well
collapsed_well.description: Caved in on itself. Whatever's down there now, it's staying down there.

ash_covered_barrels.name: Ash-Covered Barrels
ash_covered_barrels.description: Gray with soot, stacked the way people stack things when they plan on leaving in a hurry.

destroyed_market_stall.name: Wrecked Market Stall
destroyed_market_stall.description: Splintered boards and a torn awning - business, it seems, was not booming.

fallen_watchtower.name: Fallen Watchtower
fallen_watchtower.description: Toppled sideways, keeping watch now only over the ground it's lying on.

leaning_tenement.name: Leaning Tenement
leaning_tenement.description: Held up by stubbornness and a neighboring wall it is definitely not supposed to be leaning on.

laundry_line.name: Laundry Line
laundry_line.description: Strung between two buildings, still holding a shirt nobody's come back to claim.

poor_market_stall.name: Modest Market Stall
poor_market_stall.description: Threadbare canvas over a few honest goods - not much, but arranged with real care.

rain_barrel.name: Rain Barrel
rain_barrel.description: Catches every drop that falls, which around here is either a blessing or the only water anyone trusts.

crate_tarp_shanty.name: Crate-and-Tarp Shanty
crate_tarp_shanty.description: Someone's whole home, built from other people's leftovers and held up by sheer will.

patched_pushcart.name: Patched Pushcart
patched_pushcart.description: Mended so many times it's less 'one cart' than 'a committee of repairs that agreed to travel together.'

street_water_pump.name: Street Water Pump
street_water_pump.description: Squeaks loudly on the up-stroke, quietly on the down - the whole street knows when someone's fetching water.

crate_stack_cat.name: Crate Stack (Occupied)
crate_stack_cat.description: A tidy stack of crates with a cat on top, radiating the specific authority of something that pays no rent.

alley_lantern_post.name: Alley Lantern Post
alley_lantern_post.description: Casts just enough light to see the alley and just little enough to wish it didn't.

beggars_bedroll.name: Bedroll
beggars_bedroll.description: Rolled out against a wall, careful and neat - the only possession here that's easy to pack fast.

wooden_bed.name: Wooden Bed
wooden_bed.description: Simple, sturdy, and considerably more comfortable than it has any visual right to look.

dining_table_chairs.name: Dining Table & Chairs
dining_table_chairs.description: Set for more people than currently live here - old habit, or quiet hope.

stone_fireplace.name: Stone Fireplace
stone_fireplace.description: Cold now, but the stones still hold a little warmth, like they haven't quite given up on the idea of fire.

wooden_chest.name: Wooden Chest
wooden_chest.description: Locked, heavy, and giving off the specific energy of something that has opinions about being opened.

tavern_bar_counter.name: Tavern Bar Counter
tavern_bar_counter.description: Scarred with a hundred forgotten toasts and at least one axe mark nobody will explain.

stacked_ale_barrels.name: Stacked Ale Barrels
stacked_ale_barrels.description: Three barrels high and one bad decision away from becoming two barrels wide.

bookshelf.name: Bookshelf
bookshelf.description: Crammed with books on subjects nobody in town claims to have ever needed. Someone clearly disagreed.

standing_torch_sconce.name: Standing Torch Sconce
standing_torch_sconce.description: Burns steady and bright, apparently unbothered by drafts that would snuff anything smaller.

barred_cell_section.name: Barred Cell
barred_cell_section.description: Empty, for now. The bars look sturdy. The optimism about staying out of them, less so.

throne.name: Throne
throne.description: Ornate, uncomfortable-looking, and clearly built to be admired rather than actually sat in for long.

castle_wall_section.name: Castle Wall
castle_wall_section.description: Thick, gray stone that has shrugged off more history than most people ever learn.

castle_gate_tower.name: Gate Tower
castle_gate_tower.description: Tall enough to see trouble coming from a good distance - assuming anyone's actually up there looking.

drawbridge.name: Drawbridge
drawbridge.description: Down at the moment, which either means visitors are welcome or nobody remembered to raise it.

portcullis.name: Portcullis
portcullis.description: A wall of iron teeth, currently open, currently very interested in staying that way.

corner_turret.name: Corner Turret
corner_turret.description: A narrow tower with an excellent view and, presumably, a very cold night shift.

castle_banner_wallmount.name: Castle Banner
castle_banner_wallmount.description: Hangs heavy and still in air that, for some reason, refuses to move it.

siege_ballista.name: Siege Ballista
siege_ballista.description: Aimed at the horizon and clearly built by someone who took the horizon personally.

courtyard_well.name: Courtyard Well
courtyard_well.description: Deeper than the village well, and considerably better maintained - royalty does have its perks.

armory_rack.name: Armory Rack
armory_rack.description: Rows of polished weapons that have clearly been oiled more recently than they've been used.

castle_stairs.name: Castle Stairs
castle_stairs.description: Worn into a gentle curve by centuries of people in a hurry to be somewhere more important.

stalactite_cluster.name: Stalactite Cluster
stalactite_cluster.description: Hanging in a neat row, dripping on a schedule that's had thousands of years to get precise.

stalagmite_formation.name: Stalagmite Formation
stalagmite_formation.description: Rising to meet its ceiling counterpart, one patient drop of mineral at a time.

underground_pool.name: Underground Pool
underground_pool.description: Still, dark, and clear enough to see down much further than feels reassuring.

cave_in_rubble.name: Cave-In Rubble
cave_in_rubble.description: A wall of collapsed rock. Whatever tunnel this used to be, it isn't anymore.

glowing_crystal_cluster.name: Glowing Crystal Cluster
glowing_crystal_cluster.description: Pulses faintly with light that has no obvious source and no interest in explaining itself.

mine_cart.name: Mine Cart
mine_cart.description: Rusted onto its rails, still loaded with ore nobody ever came back for.

support_beam.name: Support Beam
support_beam.description: Groans occasionally under the weight of the mountain above it - purely for effect, one hopes.

underground_fungus_growth.name: Underground Fungus Growth
underground_fungus_growth.description: Pale, spongy, and thriving somewhere sunlight has never once bothered to visit.

cave_torch_sconce.name: Cave Torch Sconce
cave_torch_sconce.description: Lit and burning steadily, though nobody's admitted to lighting it.

bat_roost.name: Bat Roost
bat_roost.description: Quiet right now. Best to keep it that way and move along quickly.

runic_standing_stone.name: Runic Standing Stone
runic_standing_stone.description: Carved with symbols that predate every language currently spoken here, and somehow still feel legible.

broken_arcane_statue.name: Broken Arcane Statue
broken_arcane_statue.description: Missing an arm and most of its face, but the posture still reads as deeply unimpressed.

ley_light_wisp_cluster.name: Ley-Light Wisps
ley_light_wisp_cluster.description: Small lights drifting in slow loops, tracing a shape that might be a pattern or might just be showing off.

sunken_archway.name: Sunken Archway
sunken_archway.description: Half-buried in earth, leading to a doorway that used to matter to somebody, once.

rune_circle.name: Rune Circle
rune_circle.description: Etched into the ground in a perfect ring. Standing in the middle feels like a decision, not an accident.

ancient_obelisk.name: Ancient Obelisk
ancient_obelisk.description: Stands taller than it should be able to, given how little of it is actually touching the ground.

shattered_mirror_shard.name: Shattered Mirror Shard
shattered_mirror_shard.description: Reflects the sky correctly. Reflects Lara about half a second late.

moss_grown_altar.name: Moss-Grown Altar
moss_grown_altar.description: Whatever used to be offered here, the moss has taken over the job with real enthusiasm.

buried_relic_case.name: Buried Relic Case
buried_relic_case.description: Sealed tight and half-sunk in dirt, holding something someone once thought was worth protecting forever.

whispering_well.name: Whispering Well
whispering_well.description: Lean in and it whispers back - never quite words, but never quite nothing, either.

distant_treeline.name: Distant Treeline
distant_treeline.description: Forest stretching to the horizon, hazy with distance and entirely, comfortably out of reach.

misty_ridge.name: Misty Ridge
misty_ridge.description: A ridge of hills wrapped in fog that never seems to lift, burn off, or explain itself.

distant_hills.name: Distant Hills
distant_hills.description: Rolling and blue-gray with distance - closer than they look, or maybe exactly as far as they look.

dense_treeline.name: Dense Treeline
dense_treeline.description: A wall of dark forest at the edge of everything, thick enough to swallow sound as well as light.

misty_peaks.name: Misty Peaks
misty_peaks.description: Mountains fading into cloud at the top, like even they weren't sure how high to go.

stone_wall_corner.name: Stone Wall Corner
stone_wall_corner.description: Where two walls meet at a right angle, exactly as walls have agreed to do since walls were invented.

stone_wall_corner_alt.name: Stone Wall Corner
stone_wall_corner_alt.description: The other kind of corner. Structurally identical to its cousin; aesthetically, very particular about the difference.

stone_archway.name: Stone Archway
stone_archway.description: A doorway with no door, which somehow feels more deliberate than an oversight.

stone_wall_window.name: Stone Wall Window
stone_wall_window.description: A narrow slit of a window, built for archers rather than anyone hoping for a nice view.

wall_torch_sconce.name: Wall Torch Sconce
wall_torch_sconce.description: Mounted at exactly the height to leave soot on the ceiling directly above it, forever.

wall_tapestry.name: Wall Tapestry
wall_tapestry.description: Depicts a battle, a feast, or possibly both, depending on how long you squint at it.

stone_wall_skirting.name: Stone Wall Skirting
stone_wall_skirting.description: The unglamorous bit where wall meets floor. Somebody still carved it carefully.

cracked_stone_floor.name: Cracked Stone Floor
cracked_stone_floor.description: Fractured in a pattern that looks less like wear and more like something once pushed up from underneath.

floor_rubble_patch.name: Floor Rubble Patch
floor_rubble_patch.description: A scatter of broken stone underfoot. Watch your step; it hasn't finished settling.

worn_floor_rug.name: Worn Floor Rug
worn_floor_rug.description: Threadbare in the middle, from what must have been a great deal of pacing.
